name: Soft Aurora
description: WebGL2 shader background of soft flowing aurora bands with grain, a spectrum color cycle, cursor-reactive bending, click pulses and an intro fade-in. Supports dark and light page modes.
contents: Container div with a single full-size WebGL canvas drawing the aurora fragment shader
behavior: Two layered Perlin noise bands flow over time and shift hue along the horizontal axis
Pointer position bends the band near the cursor and shifts the noise field with smoothed easing
Click or tap inside the container sends a ripple pulse across the bands, up to 4 at once
Intro animation ramps brightness and band sharpness over about 2 seconds on first mount
Rendering pauses when offscreen or the tab is hidden and resumes automatically
Reduced motion preference slows the flow, skips the intro and disables click pulses
Canvas resolution is scaled down based on noiseFrequency and scale for performance
Recovers from WebGL context loss by rebuilding the program
editableByProps: Two aurora colors, brightness, opacity and the spectrum color cycle amount and speed
Flow speed, noise scale, frequency, amplitude, octave decay, band height, spread, layer offset and tilt
Cursor interaction, click pulses and intro animation toggles
Dark or light page rendering via lightMode
Sizing and placement through className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change pulse lifetime or intro duration
needsCodeEdit.where: pulse age check of 2.6 and opening dt / 2 inside the frame function

fixed: Requires WebGL2, renders nothing if unsupported or shader compile fails
Root is h-full w-full, so the parent must have a defined height or the className must set one
Does not set a background, it draws transparent glow, so place it over a dark background or set lightMode on light pages
Listens to pointer events on window and document, so mouse reaction works even when content sits above the canvas (canvas has no pointer events of its own)
Canvas is aria-hidden and purely decorative
Runs a continuous animation loop while visible and speed is above 0, which is GPU heavy on low-end mobile
